notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: two sources only, the FFLA roster (gone, coordinates matching the record) and a TopoZone map-feature listing (USGS-derived; no date, builder, height or removal date). Two WebSearch calls and two page reads used, none turned up a St. Louis County tower PDF or any history. The TopoZone 'nearby towers' names are for orientation only and are not claims about those towers' status. Record fields match the sources; no corrections proposed. Worth a human look for a St. Louis County lookout inventory or a Kabustasa Lake site visit report before publishing more than the status. The story runs at about 120 words, the floor of the range, and says nothing about build or fate beyond the status.
